verdict.rationale: Gusto's own press release says developers and power users can drive Gusto through its MCP server or a one-command CLI, and can connect AI tools to prep payroll and generate reports (gusto-docs-10, gusto-docs-12, gusto-docs-22). These are first-party programmatic interfaces, but the evidence never describes a documented public API with reference docs, endpoints, or auth, and the only source is a press release. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented public REST/HTTP API, API reference documentation, auth/scoping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
